name: aethersmp
description: AetherSMP — сайт Minecraft SMP сервера: расы, личный кабинет, супер-админка

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @aethersmp/api" "npm run dev -w @aethersmp/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @aethersmp/api && npm run build -w @aethersmp/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @aethersmp/api" "npm run start -w @aethersmp/web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @aethersmp/api && npm run lint -w @aethersmp/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @aethersmp/api && npm run typecheck -w @aethersmp/web
